restoration_group: Author confirmed that restoration animals were selected from successfully modeled rats and continued; separate model rats underwent terminal sampling at week 4.
terminal_tissue_analysis: Independent cohorts; no paired longitudinal tissue test inferred from common model origin.
two_conflicting_plate_wells: The author subsequently confirmed annotation errors after checking original sample-loading or laboratory records: B10-Ch5=Nox1 model, D12-Ch5=Nox4 sham. Original exports and Cq values unchanged.
date_scope: At the author's request, this round does not further investigate run-year/approval-time correspondence. Original dates, metadata and ethics number are unchanged; correspondence is not declared verified.
QC_status: Two annotation errors explicitly documented; target specificity, animal identity linkage and original ethics documentation remain unresolved.
clarification_history: Further author confirmation: original sample-loading or laboratory records checked; both sample identities correct.
current_source_record_availability: Author stated that no ethics approval letter, approved protocol, or animal-to-sample/submission/loading records are currently available to supply.
animal_n_and_pairing_basis: Investigator confirmation: six different rats per group; one target and reference measurement per rat; same-column pairing; no inter-animal pooling. Current exports support numerical pairing but cannot independently recover animal identity.
plate_annotation_basis: Prior investigator confirmation after source-record review; the supporting loading or laboratory record has not been supplied for independent review. Table S2 preserves exact well identities, original annotation, corrected interpretation, reference well and source cells.
ethics_approval_basis: Investigators report AHUCM-rats-2022032 covered the study. Approval letter and approved protocol are currently unavailable for retrospective verification.
welfare: No postoperative analgesia; no retained documented rationale or specific authorization for omission. Nine of 50 modeled rats died: six intraoperative, three subsequent; 18%.
